items.summary: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security disposition and private launch gates. Continue bounded read-only evidence capture only; access, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, monitoring, incident, TLS, and disclosure controls remain unverified.

Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS coverage, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not proof of compromise. Exact decision: maintain private launch gates, continue bounded read-only evidence capture, and permit only reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Continue existing bounded read-only security evidence work only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, build and deployment provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incident handling, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, modify production, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach.

Keep the gated product private. Public exposure, alert expansion, deployment, configuration or credential changes, dependency additions, and external outreach remain blocked until security evidence and the outstanding rights, privacy, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are complete.
